_note: SAMPLE SEED DATA for the Permit Pal hackathon demo. These entries are realistic but simplified and MUST be verified against official municipal sources before any real-world use. They stand in for a production retrieval layer over municipal code APIs.

jurisdictions.authority: City of Austin Development Services Department
jurisdictions.name: Austin, TX

fees.permit: $0.35 per sq ft over 200 sq ft (sample)

inspections.label: Footing inspection
inspections.when: After excavation, before concrete is poured

inspections.label: Framing inspection
inspections.when: After joists/beams are set, before decking is installed

inspections.label: Final inspection
inspections.when: After all work is complete, including stairs and railings

deck-addition.label: Deck addition
required_documents: Completed residential building permit application form
Site plan showing lot lines, setbacks, and impervious-cover calculation
Construction drawings: plan view, elevations, and cross-sections
Structural details: joist/beam spans, footing sizes and depths
Property survey or plot plan (if available)
HOA approval letter (if in a deed-restricted subdivision)

requirements.detail: Required for decks over 200 sq ft, attached to the dwelling, or more than 30 inches above grade at any point.
requirements.title: Residential building permit

requirements.detail: 5 ft minimum side and rear setbacks in most residential districts; impervious-cover limits apply (verify against lot survey).
requirements.title: Zoning and setback compliance

requirements.detail: Joist/beam spans, footing sizes and depths, ledger attachment or freestanding details. Prescriptive details from the IRC may be used for standard decks.
requirements.title: Structural drawings

requirements.detail: Additional review if the lot is in a floodplain, water-quality transition zone, or Edwards Aquifer recharge zone.
requirements.title: Environmental review (conditional)

requirements.detail: Approval letter required if the property is in a deed-restricted subdivision with an active HOA.
requirements.title: HOA approval (conditional)

requirements.detail: Separate electrical permit for deck lighting/outlets; plumbing permit if an outdoor sink or gas line is included.
requirements.title: Trade permits (conditional)

deck-addition.typical_timeline: 10-15 business days from complete submittal to permit issuance (sample)

inspections.label: Rough-in inspection (electrical/plumbing)
inspections.when: After systems are installed, before insulation or drywall

inspections.label: Insulation / drywall inspection
inspections.when: After insulation, before drywall is hung

inspections.label: Final inspection
inspections.when: After all finishes, fixtures, and appliances are installed

kitchen-remodel.label: Kitchen remodel
required_documents: Completed residential remodel permit application form
Floor plans: existing conditions and proposed layout
Electrical plan: circuits, outlets, lighting, panel schedule
Plumbing plan (if fixtures move or are added)
Structural details (if walls are removed or openings cut)

requirements.detail: Required when moving or removing walls, altering the structure, or touching electrical, plumbing, or mechanical systems. Like-for-like cabinet/countertop swaps with no system changes may be exempt.
requirements.title: Residential remodel permit

requirements.detail: Engineered details required if a load-bearing wall is removed or a new opening is cut.
requirements.title: Structural review (conditional)

requirements.detail: Dedicated small-appliance circuits, GFCI protection, and lighting layout per the electrical code.
requirements.title: Electrical plan

requirements.detail: Required if fixtures are relocated or added; backflow prevention where applicable.
requirements.title: Plumbing plan (conditional)

requirements.detail: IECC compliance for new lighting and any envelope changes (windows/doors).
requirements.title: Energy code compliance

requirements.detail: General contractor and trade contractors must hold active City of Austin registrations.
requirements.title: Contractor registration

kitchen-remodel.typical_timeline: 15-20 business days from complete submittal to permit issuance (sample)

inspections.label: Framing inspection
inspections.when: After structural framing, before decking boards

inspections.label: Final inspection
inspections.when: After completion of stairs, guards, and handrails

deck-addition.label: Deck addition
required_documents: Site plan with lot dimensions, setbacks, and ECA boundaries (if any)
Structural details or prescriptive deck detail sheets

requirements.detail: Required for decks more than 30 inches above grade or attached to the house. Low, detached platforms may be exempt.
requirements.title: Residential building permit

requirements.detail: Steep slopes, wetlands, or shoreline buffers trigger ECA review and may restrict deck placement.
requirements.title: Environmentally Critical Areas review (conditional)

requirements.detail: Prescriptive Deck Details (based on the IRC) or engineered drawings for non-standard spans and soils.
requirements.title: Structural plans

requirements.detail: Downspout and surface-water discharge must not impact neighboring properties.
requirements.title: Drainage control

requirements.detail: Rear-yard coverage and setback standards per the Seattle Land Use Code for the lot's zone.
requirements.title: Land-use compliance

requirements.detail: Required for layout changes, structural work, or electrical/plumbing/mechanical alterations. Cosmetic-only refreshes are typically exempt.
requirements.title: Residential alteration permit

requirements.detail: Lighting power density and controls must meet the Seattle Energy Code for altered spaces.
requirements.title: Seattle Energy Code

requirements.detail: Circuit layouts, GFCI/AFCI protection, and plumbing isometrics for relocated fixtures.
requirements.title: Electrical and plumbing details

requirements.detail: Required when removing walls or modifying the lateral system; seismic anchorage notes for equipment.
requirements.title: Structural details (conditional)

jurisdictions.authority: City and County of Denver Community Planning and Development
jurisdictions.name: Denver, CO

inspections.label: Footing inspection
inspections.when: After excavation to 36 in. depth, before concrete

inspections.label: Final inspection
inspections.when: After stairs, guards, and all finishes

deck-addition.label: Deck addition
required_documents: Site plan with setbacks and lot coverage
Structural details: footings (36 in. min depth), framing, connections
Soils/geotechnical note for non-prescriptive designs (if applicable)

requirements.detail: Required for decks over 30 inches above grade, attached to the dwelling, or roofed/covered.
requirements.title: Residential building permit

requirements.detail: Footings must extend to 36 inches below grade (Denver frost depth).
requirements.title: Frost-depth footings

requirements.detail: Primary-structure setbacks apply; verify against the Denver Zoning Code for the zone district.
requirements.title: Zoning setbacks

requirements.detail: Joist/beam spans, post bases, and lateral bracing per the IRC as amended by Denver.
requirements.title: Structural details

requirements.detail: Landmark Preservation review for properties in historic districts or individual landmarks.
requirements.title: Historic district review (conditional)

requirements.detail: Required for layout changes, structural modifications, or electrical/plumbing/mechanical work.
requirements.title: Residential alteration permit

requirements.detail: Small-appliance branch circuits, GFCI protection, and lighting per the Denver Building Code.
requirements.title: Electrical plan

requirements.detail: Required for fixture relocations or additions; water-service sizing where affected.
requirements.title: Plumbing plan (conditional)

requirements.detail: Compliance for altered lighting and envelope components.
requirements.title: Energy code (IECC)
